title: Quote.Trade MCP Adapter
description: Quote.Trade MCP: login, deposit address, market data, orders, and withdraws.
summary: Quote.Trade MCP: login, deposit address, market data, orders, and withdraws.
offersHint: Quote.Trade MCP: login, deposit address, market data, orders, and withdraws. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://quote.trade/mcp · Optional headers: X-MBX-APIKEY, X-Quote-Trade-API-Secret

headers.name: X-MBX-APIKEY
headers.description: Quote.Trade API key from wallet login/logon. Required for private tools.

headers.name: X-Quote-Trade-API-Secret
headers.description: Sent only to this MCP host so it can HMAC-sign private calls. Downstream APIs get X-MBX-APIKEY + signature, not this secret.

headerDocs.name: X-MBX-APIKEY
headerDocs.description: Quote.Trade API key from wallet login/logon. Required for private tools.

headerDocs.name: X-Quote-Trade-API-Secret
headerDocs.description: Sent only to this MCP host so it can HMAC-sign private calls. Downstream APIs get X-MBX-APIKEY + signature, not this secret.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_api_manifest
toolsPreview.description: Explains that MCP is only a tool/schema adapter around the existing Quote.Trade APIs, and returns local servlet guardrail configuration.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_get_challenge
toolsPreview.description: Login/register step 1. POST /api/getChallenge with a wallet address (login). Returns challenge text and isNewUser. Step 2: sign the challenge with the wallet outside MCP (no backend). Step 3: quote_trade_logon with the same isNewUser flag. No API key required.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_logon
toolsPreview.description: Login/register step 3. Pass challenge + wallet signature from steps 1–2. If isNewUser=true (from get_challenge), calls POST /api/registerUser; otherwise POST /api/logon. On success, body.requestToken and body.requestSecret are the API credentials: set them as MCP headers X-MBX-APIKEY and X-Quote-Trade-API-Secret; use body.id as account. Wallet signing stays outside MCP.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_get_deposit_address
toolsPreview.description: Deposit step 1. GET /api/getDepositAddress?symbol=ASSET and return chain + contract/address. Supported assets: USDC and USDT (mainnet), XUSDC (USDC on XDC). Step 2 is transferring funds to that address outside MCP (no backend call).

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_status
toolsPreview.description: Call GET /api/status and return system status, server time, contracts URL, and feature flags.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_exchange_info
toolsPreview.description: Call GET /api/exchangeInfo and return trading symbols, assets, status, rate limits, and server time.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_instruments
toolsPreview.description: Trade step 1. GET /api/getInstrumentPairs — list tradable symbols/instruments supported by Quote.Trade. Pick a symbol from this response for ticker/depth/order calls.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_ticker
toolsPreview.description: Trade step 2. GET /api/ticker?symbol=SYMBOL for a symbol from quote_trade_instruments. Returns last price, bid, ask, lastUpdateId.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_depth
toolsPreview.description: Trade step 3. GET /api/depth?symbol=SYMBOL&limit=N. Use depth quantity to choose a suitable limit price before placing an order.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_account
toolsPreview.description: Withdraw step 1 / anytime account check. GET /api/account with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Inspect available balances before withdraw. No live trading action.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_order_preview
toolsPreview.description: Optional before live trade. Normalize/validate a BUY/SELL order locally without sending it.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_place_order
toolsPreview.description: Trade step 4. POST /api/order with a suitable price after instruments/ticker/depth. Requires enableTrading=true and per-request API credentials. Empty allowedSymbols allows any Quote.Trade instrument; maxNotionalUsd<=0 means unlimited. humanApproved/approvalText are agent friction only.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_withdraw_preview
toolsPreview.description: Optional before live withdraw. Normalize/validate a withdraw-to-own-wallet request locally without sending it. Destination address is not accepted; backend uses the user's login wallet.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_withdraw
toolsPreview.description: Withdraw step 3. After quote_trade_account and balance check, POST /api/sendWithdrawWithVTokenRequest for the selected asset/quantity to the user's own wallet only (no toAddress; backend uses login wallet). Requires enableTrading and per-request API credentials. humanApproved/approvalText are agent friction only.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_liquidity_sample
toolsPreview.description: Open wss://app.quote.trade/ws/liquidity, subscribe to a symbol, collect a bounded number of messages, then close.

toolsPreview.name: quote_trade_private_events_sample
toolsPreview.description: Open wss://app.quote.trade/ws/listenKey using the caller's per-request X-MBX-APIKEY, collect bounded account/order/risk messages, then close. No live trading action is performed.
